gold_only.description: Standard supervised training on verified ground truth

weak_label_assisted_raw.description: Supervised training using raw majority-vote LF noisy labels

weak_label_reviewed_corrections.description: Adjudicated LF supervision with conflict-resolution rules

findings: Weak supervision provides 38.4% coverage over unlabeled dialogue. Raw majority vote introduces slight label noise (F1: 0.832 vs 0.861), but human-reviewed adjudication restores high macro performance (F1: 0.858) while expanding annotation efficiency.
